title: Research a company
summary: Finds the company's own pages and other sources, extracts facts, and keeps only those whose quote appears word for word in the archived page. You approve the plan first. Every claim is shown with its quote, source and a support verdict.

question.title: What do you want to know?
question.description: For example: Which patent families cover the MoReTec chemical recycling technology?

allow_capabilities.title: Pause and ask me for a data source if the web pages are not enough
